scope.market_card_fields_reviewed: Treasury prior curve/spreads/20-observation changes/shape/move, and all quoted instrument close/session/1-, 5-, 20-session horizons, currencies, unit and history restrictions. Each quoted field was checked against the own-date card.

checks_performed: Actual prose and every cited headline read, paragraph by paragraph; this receipt is not a count-only or script-only certification.
Own-date headline attribution, actor, Polish translation, factual extent, and every numeric identity/unit/currency/horizon checked.
Semantic seven-day company news/preview, fourteen-day company results, thirty-five-day macro windows reviewed.
Actual release before midnight UTC, actual versus preview, event calendar, prior-close versus post-close earnings and election conditionality checked.
Actions, stances, invalidation, repeated boilerplate, numeric spot FX prohibition, corporate-action restrictions and short-history restrictions checked.
Retail and retail_intro preserved exactly by patch assertions; retail prose was outside this review scope.

concrete_findings.finding: The last two catalyst blocks were broad China-policy and Poland scenarios rather than single companies; all six titles lacked the required ticker-title form.
concrete_findings.resolution: Replaced those two blocks with HSBC and PKO BP using already-read own-date headlines n2030, n3741, n3297 and exact own-card HSBA.L/PKO.WA fields. All six blocks now name one company and use the $TICKER — thesis form, with coherent actions and invalidation.

concrete_findings.finding: Two exposure paragraphs lacked named instruments, making the themes insufficiently actionable.
concrete_findings.resolution: Distinguished Bitcoin asset exposure from a COIN business thesis; replaced the uninvestable broad security-technology theme with PGE operating-capacity analysis supported by n3871/n3895 and exact PGE.WA card fields. Security technology remains covered in Poland.

concrete_findings.finding: Property stabilization was described as occurring after subdued conditions, while n1167 says stabilization in2025 but subdued conditions for years.
concrete_findings.resolution: Restored the concurrent horizon and attributed it as reported expectations rather than CNBC's own forecast.

concrete_findings.finding: The curve move was paraphrased rather than using the required own-card wording.
concrete_findings.resolution: Used bear steepening (both up, 10Y up more) exactly.

concrete_findings.finding: Price response was treated as information about positioning; eligibility and commissioned-capacity language also exceeded the cleanest supported scope.
concrete_findings.resolution: Price response now changes the valuation available to a buyer; removed eligibility narration and used plant launch/newly launched capacity consistent with the exact headline.

concrete_findings.finding: Microsoft and AMD citations were repeated to four uses despite redundant or interchangeable examples.
concrete_findings.resolution: Removed a redundant Microsoft mention; used exact Reuters PayPal forecast example for the forward-revenue risk, leaving n1975/n1996/n1180 at three uses each.

concrete_findings.finding: The initial replacement cloned the numeric sentence already in Poland, producing a verifier repetition warning.
concrete_findings.resolution: Rephrased that sentence while retaining exact price, daily return and20-session return; final verifier has no warnings.

AMD's October29 regular-session gain is never called a positive reaction to its later disappointing forecast; the result direction is attributed to CNBC independently.
Microsoft and Amazon results remain pending. Pfizer, BP, HSBC, Novartis, McDonalds and D.R. Horton October29 results/warnings are completed rather than previews.

Woolworths n0470 is treated as an early Australian morning company-release warning available on the prior UTC evening; this differs from Australian CPI during October30UTC. Precise original article vintage is not independently authenticated.
US October30 GDP and Australia October30 CPI actuals are not used. Australia inflation remains a preview, and the BOJ decision remains pending.
ASML October15 actual result is outside fourteen days on October30 and is absent. ASML appears only through exact own-card price and return comparisons.
China USD1.4trillion debt consideration remains conditional; EV tariff action is distinguished from future retaliation and company earnings consequences.
All known stale-company exclusions for October30 are absent; US election and Japan government formation remain unresolved.
